neighbours.label: ' in' right after a passive participle of publishing or making available ('published in', 'posted in', 'available in'), as against other prepositions after the same participles
fire: Her first short story was published in a literary magazine in 2004.
A notice about the closure was posted in the town hall window.
The full report was printed in the Sunday edition of the paper.
The new edition is now available in most bookstores.
The findings were reported in a medical journal last month.
His letter to the mayor was published in the evening paper.
The job advertisement was posted in several trade magazines.
The course materials are available in the student portal.
quiet: Her first short story was published by a small press in 2004.
A notice about the closure was posted on the town hall door.
The full report was printed by the city council last week.
The new edition is now available from most bookstores.
The findings were reported by a team of doctors last month.
His letter to the mayor was published on the paper's website.
The job advertisement was posted on several job boards.
The course materials are available through the student portal.
